Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this game! Bangladesh did put up a fight for a while but eventually lost the plot, especially on the final day. Sri Lanka will be elated with their efforts, they are back to winning ways after returning home. The next match will take place in the capital city, Colombo, on 15th March, 2017 at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Will the Tigers draw level or will the Lions clinch the series? Do join us to find out. Until then, goodbye and take care! Have an exciting weekend, folks!

SRI LANKAN CAPTAIN, RANGANA HERATH is absolutely delighted with the record of becoming the most successful left-arm spinner in Test history. He thanks all those people who were right behind him and reckons that's the reason for his success. On the match, he says everything went on track but still there is room for improvement. Praises Kusal Mendis and Upul Tharanga for their knocks and concludes by saying he's enjoying his captaincy and he's getting good support from his mates.

BANGLADESHI CAPTAIN, MUSHFIQUR RAHIM says that it was a good pitch and wasn't that bad even on the final day. Congratulates the Lankan team for their victory and Herath for his individual glory. Laments the batting failure in the first innings which cost them big. Praises the bowlers for their efforts and feels that the batsmen let the team down. Expresses pleasure at the openers doing well and that gave his team hope at the start of the final day but again opines that the batsmen didn't apply themselves. Doesn't feel that they were a batsman short and also doesn't think that the no ball reprieve of Mendis off the first ball as a big moment in the game. Quickly adds that such things happen in cricket and admits that his team was outplayed totally in all departments.

KUSAL MENDIS (MAN OF THE MATCH) thanks the team and support staff for all the backing during his lean patch in recent times. He spoke in local dialect and the general meaning of his words were translated by Roshan Abeysinghe.

Bangladesh had a good start with both openers getting fifties in the first innings but then slumped with the middle order caving in. Rahim's 85 and his stand with Mehedi ensured that the follow-on was avoided but still the lead conceded was big. Tharanga's ton along with a Chandimal fifty gave Sri Lanka a lead that put the contest beyond Bangladesh. The visitors failed to capitalize on the good starts in both innings and paid a heavy price.

Rahim was the only batsman today to show some fight while Sarkar stroked a fluent fifty yesterday. Apart from the duo, there wasn't anything from the visitors in the fourth innings. Sri Lanka after opting to bat posted a fairly big score thanks to Mendis' brilliant 194. He got support from Gunaratne and Dickwella while Perera too chipped in. Mehedi was the most successful bowler for Bangladesh but the visitors were off color especially on the first day. Roy was extremely unlucky despite bowling quite well.

A purely clinical win by the Lankans as they go 1-0 up in the two-match Test series. Chasing a mammoth target of 457 was always going to be tough but Bangladesh did have a glimmer of hope of saving the game after the nice start by their openers yesterday. However, the Lankans were relentless today and the wicket in the first over of the day set the tone for the hosts. After lying low in the first four days, Herath came roaring into the party with a 6-fer, also becoming the most successful left-arm spinner in Tests.

OUT! In the air... gone! Rangana Herath wraps it up with a 6-fer! He has his hands aloft, a veteran for a reason! He gives it a nice flight once again around off, Mehedi Hasan tries to loft it down the ground but doesn't get enough meat on it. It's mistimed towards mid off where Lahiru Kumara moves a couple of steps back and takes a reverse cup catch over his head. That's it, SRI LANKA WIN BY 259 RUNS!
Gives it a nice flight and serves it around off, Mehedi presses forward in defense.
Perera comes from over the wicket and floats it up outside off, Roy punches it back to the bowler.
Darts it around middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Stays put and blocks it out.
Floats it up outside off, turning in as Hasan looks to push it away on the off side but the ball goes under his bat and into the keeper's gloves.
Loopy ball around off, once again defended down.
Flatter through the air around middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Quicker ball on middle and leg, gets back and whips it away on the leg side for a single to keep strike.
Fired in around middle, a hint of away turn as Mehedi pushes at it but gets a faint edge that falls well short of slip.
Flatter around middle, blocked off the inside half towards short leg.
Full and outside off, another firm drive through the covers and Mehedi doesn't take the single.
Drifting in from around off, well blocked off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and drives it to sweeper cover. Declines the single.
DOESN'T CARRY! Floated off break outside off, Roy pushes at it with hard hands but gets an inside edge on to the pads. The ball doesn't carry to the man at short leg.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
Flatter outside off, stays back and punches it to the off side for a single.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and defends solidly.
Flatter around off, Mehedi hangs back and defends solidly. Adjusted well to the low bounce.
Flighted on middle, Roy makes a bit of room and defends well.
Floated and around off, presses forward and blocks it solidly.
SUBASHIS ROY is the last man in.
29th five-wicket haul in Tests for Herath, 9th at Galle. No wonder he loves this ground the most. It's also his 3rd as skipper.

OUT! CLEANS HIM UP! Yet another fifer for the veteran. Floated in from around off, straightens a bit after pitching as Mustafizur plays inside the line. Misses it completely and sees the rattle of timber behind him. Another one bites the dust and SRI LANKA NEED JUST ONE WICKET.
Full and around off, turning in, Mustafizur nudges it with the turn towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in from around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
FOUR! Gets it away fine! Drifting in on the stumps, Mehedi gets a neat paddle down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Nicely done by the young man.
SIX! Clubbed! Mehedi wants to have some fun now as the game is literally over. Finds it in his arc around middle and slog sweeps it with the turn over deep square leg for a biggie.
Loopy around middle, Mehedi gets across and pats it towards short leg.
Flighted outside off, presses forward to that one and pats it towards cover.
FOUR! Bad ball and hammered! Half-tracker on leg stump, sits on the back foot and hammers the pull through backward square leg for a boundary.
Flatter and outside off, the slider and Mehedi is beaten on the poke.
DILRUWAN PERERA is back on.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN is the new man in, replacing Taskin!

OUT! Herath has his fourth! Nicely looped around off, Taskin pushes at it with hard hands. Turns in sharply off the deck with extra bounce and forces the inside edge that crashes into the pads before settling into Mendis' hands at short leg. Easy catch and SRI LANKA JUST TWO WICKETS AWAY.
Fuller outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, gets well forward and defends solidly.
Flatter and outside off, leans forward and blocks it solidly.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and blocks it well.
Floated on middle, another wrong 'un spins down leg as Taskin lets it pass.

Floated and outside off, spinning in, Taskin looks to drive but is beaten on the inside edge. Stays low and just goes past off stump. Gets through Dickwella as well and goes to the deep. Sandakan has overstepped and it's a no ball. The batsmen have got a brace.
The leg spinner from Sandakan and Taskin is beaten on the drive.
Floated around off, leans forward and works it towards mid-wicket.

What happened there? Taskin almost did a Tamim! The wrong 'un and he is beaten on the flick as it slides down the leg side. He almost set off from the crease but then got back in time. Has a wry smile on his face. He isn't picking Sandakan one little bit.
Tossed up around off, very full and Taskin digs it out just in time. Almost yorked himself.
Drifting away outside off, turning away as Taskin makes a leave.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
FOUR! Runs for Mehedi! Looks to drive a fuller ball and it is a bit uppish as it goes off the outer half. The ball races through point for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and drives it towards mid off.
Nicely bowled! Drifting in from outside off, Mehedi looks to play at it but gets beaten by the turn.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Flatter on middle and leg, gets across and clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in from around off, Mehedi presses forward and defends it solidly.
Two byes! Sandakan loses his radar and sprays it way down the leg side. It spins further down and Dickwella cannot get to it. The ball rolls to fine leg as the batsmen get a couple.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! Another wrong 'un and almost has Taskin who looks to play back to that one. Gets a faint bit of bat on it to clip it down the leg side. There is a stutter as they go for the third run and the throw is good at the keeper's end where Dickwella does the rest. The umpire goes upstairs to check it but Mehedi is well in.
Loopy and outside off, no shot offered to that one.
The wrong 'un and Taskin has certainly not picked it. Makes a leave and is hit on the pads. Loud appeal for lbw but probably not done enough to make it a case for the umpire.
Floated outside off, leans forward and drives it towards cover.
Flatter and full on off, Mehedi pushes it gently towards the short cover.
Floated outside off, no stroke offered to that one.

NOT OUT! Tossed up outside off, Taskin eases it towards mid off for a single. Lakmal is a bit slow and fires a direct hit at the bowler's end. They are going upstairs to check the run out. Looked to be in but they want to be sure. Replays show that Taskin's feet were in the air but luckily for him, the bat was grounded.
It's a direct hit from Lakmal at the bowler's end. They have taken it upstairs but Taskin looks safe.
Taskin Ahmed is the new man in, replacing Das!

OUT! HERATH STRIKES! Now becomes the most successful left-arm spinner in Test history, overtaking Vettori. What a champion he has been for Sri Lanka! Coming to the delivery, poor shot selection from Das as he looks to go across the line to a loopy delivery from around off but gets a top edge on it. The ball bobbles towards cover where Tharanga backtracks a bit to his left to take a comfortable catch. All but over for the Bangladeshis now. SRI LANKA JUST 3 WICKETS AWAY.
Tossed up outside off, Das leans forward and blocks it solidly to the off side.
Keeps it outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Floated on middle and leg, gets across and sweeps it on the leg side for a brace.
Floated outside off, sits back and defends it well.
Flatter outside off, a bit short and nicely cut through point for a brace.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and drives it towards mid on.
Flatter outside off, gets back and jabs it to the off side.
Floated outside off, skids through with the arm as Das lets it pass.
Arrowed in on middle, Das hangs back and clips it through mid-wicket. Neatly done and a brace to the total.
Quicker ball around off, stays back and defends it firmly on to the track.
Drifting in from outside off, gets well forward and pats it to the off side.
Flighted outside off, presses forward and pushes it with the turn towards cover.
Flatter and around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
RANGANA HERATH to bowl from the other end.
A bit more loop around middle, turning in sharply as Mehedi gets back to flick. Gets it down to fine leg for a brace.
Floated on middle and leg, Mehedi stays back and defends it just in time.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side.
Full and around off, leans across and pushes it towards mid on.
MEHEDI HASAN is the new man in. Slip, short leg and silly point in place for him.

OUT! RAHIM DEPARTS! What a start for SL! Yet another batsman gets strangled down the leg side in this Test match. Floated outside leg, spinning further down as Rahim looks to tuck it around the corner. Gets a feather on it and Dickwella takes it very well behind the stumps. The caught behind appeal is vociferous and instantaneous. Rahim walks as well and that's a big wicket right after the break. SRI LANKA JUST 4 WICKETS AWAY.
On middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.

Welcome back for the second session. If Bangladesh can have a good passage till tea, they may have a realistic chance of saving the game considering the weather forecast in the final session. It will be a huge task and one feels that Sri Lanka are just a wicket away from running through the lower order. All in readiness for play to begin. LAKSHAN SANDAKAN to start after lunch.
.....DAY 5, SESSION 2.....

So, one would argue the writing is on the wall for the visitors but you never know as the great Russel Arnold says, key on such wickets is patience. If the current pair trust their defense and bat out with grit they can have a slight sniff to draw it out. With the forecast not so promising, Sri Lanka would be looking to come out just like they did in the morning and wrap it up quickly. But will they be able to do so? Let's wait and find out what happens in the next session...

Needless to say whom the session belonged to! Sri Lanka came out all guns blazing and ran through the Bangladeshi top order in a jiffy. It was Gunaratne who got the opening in the name of Sarkar and then Perera and skipper Herath joined hands. It seemed like the visitors will be blown out in this session itself but that wasn't meant to be. Their skipper, Mushfiqur Rahim once again took it upon himself and got good support from Liton Das. The duo have hung around and countered the spinners quite well, threading a vital 50-plus stand.
On a length outside off, Rahim camps back and offers the full face of the bat to block. THAT SHALL BE LUNCH ON DAY 5.
Tossed up around off, very full and Rahim drives it towards mid off.
Quicker and fuller outside off, presses well forward and bunts it to cover.
Drifting in from around off, Rahim gets down and defends firmly off the front foot.
Fuller and outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot towards cover.
Play and a miss! Flatter and outside off, turns away a bit with extra bounce as Rahim is beaten on the push.
RANGANA HERATH to bowl the final over before lunch.
Length delivery on middle, Liton defends it towards short leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and sprayed down the leg side, Das flicks it through square leg. Lahiru Kumara comes running to his left, puts in a dive to save a boundary. A couple of runs taken.
Floats it up outside off, Mushfiqur taps it towards covers and scampers through for a single.
50-run stand between Rahim and Das.
Full and around off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Liton to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but it was pitching outside leg.
Goes back and defends it down with a straight bat.

Loopy ball around middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter through the air around middle, turned towards FSL.

Full and around off, from around the wicket, defended gently off the front foot.
Change of ends for DILRUWAN PERERA!
Length ball around off, Das stays back and opens the bat face to steer it through backward point for a brace. 150 up for Bangladesh. Very handy partnership this is for the visitors.
Full and on middle, Das stays leg side of the ball a bit and drives it towards cover.
Fullish around middle, Rahim gets across and plays a premeditated paddle down towards fine leg for a single.
Around the wicket.
Good length outside off, gets back and dabs it towards the covers.

SHOT! Full and wide outside off, Das drills it through the covers. Superb stroke and the ball races to the deep where it is mopped up nicely by the fielder near the ropes. Three runs taken by the batsmen.
Floated on a length around off, Das looks to block but gets an inside edge past short leg.
ASELA GUNARATNE is back on.
Shortish again on middle and leg, fended easily by Rahim.
Wide! Short and on the leg stump, it goes well over the head of the batsman, Rahim drops his wrists to let it go. Wide called by the umpire.
Fuller on middle, bunted down past mid on. The fielder gives it a chase and keeps them down to three.
The great Russel Arnold on air says, Lahiru Kumara is coming from around the wicket to create more rough around the leg stump which might just aid the spinners. Is it?
Short and down the leg side, Liton has got nothing to do with that one.
Comes from around the wicket, there is no short leg, bowls a short ball on leg, defended down.
Fuller in length and angling in on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length ball on middle, Rahim hops and defends it down.
Floats it up around off, Das smothers it off the front foot.
Drops it a touch short on middle, Rahim pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flat and short outside off, allows the ball to come and then punches it through covers for a single.
Goes back to this one and clips it through square leg for a single.
Gets low and across to defend it off the front foot.
Loopy ball around off, turning in a bit, Mushfiqur goes back in defense.

Bangs in a short ball on middle, Liton is happy to sit under it.
A length ball just on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Short and kicking off the deck, it's well directed from Kumara. Rahim goes back and hops to fend it away, hits him on the top of the blade and rolls past a vacant short leg region for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, steered past point for a single.
Length ball, angling in, tucked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Good length ball outside off, Das comes forward, opens the bat face and gets it through backward point for a couple.
Quicker through the air around middle, Mushfiqur hangs back in defense.
Comes from around the wicket...
Gets down and sweeps it towards short fine leg for a single.
Slows it through the air around middle, defended by lunging forward.
Tossed up ball around middle, swept along the ground towards backward square leg for a single.
Comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
Flatter one down the leg side, Rahim moves inside the line to let it be.
Short and slanting down the leg side, Das ducks to evade it.
Very full and aiming on the base of the off stump, Das plays a punchy drive towards short cover.
Short of a length ball outside off, steered past backward point for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, defended firmly off the front foot.
Full and angling in, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Back of a length ball around off, defended off the back foot.
LAHIRU KUMARA comes on to the bowl for the first time in this innings.
Loopy delivery down the leg side, it's swept to deep backward square leg. One run taken.
Loopy delivery, pitched outside leg, Mushfiqur smothers it away off the front foot.
Comes nicely forward and defends it down gently.
Fires it full down the leg side, Rahim doesn't offer any stroke and it just about misses the leg pole.
Pitched outside leg, Liton sweeps it down to long leg for one.
Tossed up from over the wicket, blocked towards FSL.
Touch short on middle, pulled in front of square for a single to keep strike.
Loopy ball around off, Das comes forward to defend but the ball turns away and just beats the outside edge.
Very full on the stumps, Das jams it out back to Lakshan.
Around middle and leg, defended towards short leg.

FOUR! Swept in disdain! Floats it up around middle, Liton gets down and sweeps it beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary. He looks a bit tired after playing that shot and is down on his hunches, trying to gather his breath. Let's hope he is fine.
Short and outside off, Rahim goes back, opens the face of the bat and dabs it down to third man for a single.
Full around off, driven towards mid off.
Full and around leg, Das looks to sweep again but gets it off the gloves as the ball dies down.
Slips it down the leg side, the batsman misses his sweep.

A loud shout for don't know what from Dickwella! Fires a full ball, close to the off stump, Das comes forward and leaves it alone. Dickwella appeals, maybe he thought it brushed his pad or glove but nothing from the umpire and even from Herath.

FOUR! Sloppy! Herath tosses it up around off, it turns away a bit, Das comes down the track, gets close to the pitch of the ball and drives it past a diving mid off who dives all over it and allows it to go through for a boundary.
A slider from around off, Das prods forward and defends it towards silly point.
Beaten! Short and outside off, it turns away as Rahim winds up for a cut shot but fails to get any bat on it. Dickwella collects and shouts AAIYOOOO, which means DAMN THAT JUST MISSED!
Gets forward and across a bit to defend it in front of FSL.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, Das gets down and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Flatter outside off, Rahim taps it towards cover-point for a single.
Full around the stumps, swept through backward square leg for another single.
Full around middle, nudged away through square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off, LD lunges forward and defends it down.

NOT OUT! Pushes it quicker through the air and gets it to skid off the surface, Liton Das comes forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Herath appeals but umpire Erasmus turns it down. Sri Lanka opt for the review and replays show there was an inside edge. Had there been no bat, it could have been interesting. But nonetheless, Das survives!
An LBW appeal against Liton Das is taken upstairs!
Quicker through the air around off, Liton pushes it towards point.
Is happy to come forward and defend it down again.
Tossed up around off, Liton lunges forward and keeps it out towards the leg side.

Prods forward and blocks it out gently.

On middle and leg, the batsman gets across and defends it towards short leg.
Tossed up on off, driven towards mid on.
Full from around the wicket, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed quicker through the air, skidding through the surface as Rahim meets it with a straight bat.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to the man at short extra cover.
A slider from around off, MR covers the line and defends.
Floats it up around off, turning away, Mushfiqur is happy to defend it again.
Quicker through the air outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Loopy around off, turning in, Rahim goes back and defends it down.
Drinks break...Phenomenal start to the day for the Lankans and now only a miracle can save Bangladesh from defeat. The writing is on the wall.
Drifting in from around middle, blocked off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, spinning in a bit, Das camps back and blocks solidly.
Drifting in from outside off, defended firmly off the front foot.
Full and outside off, presses forward and defends it solidly.
Fuller on middle and leg, leans across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, Rahim pushes at it but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and blocks it solidly.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
FOUR! Nice shot! Herath tries to give it plenty of air but ends up dishing out a full toss, Rahim accepts it with glee and spanks it through the covers for a boundary.
Drifting in from around off, Rahim presses forward and blocks solidly on to the track.
Full and around off, almost another lbw situation but Rahim just gets it away with an inside edge to short leg.
Slightly short on middle, Rahim swivels and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

LAKSHAN SANDAKAN into the attack now!
LITON DAS is the new man in!

OUT! DUCK FOR MAHMUDULLAH! Sensational passage of play for the hosts. It's the drifter from Herath and Mahmudullah's bat gets jammed to his front pad while trying to defend. The ball turns away just a touch off the deck to ping him on the back pad. It's as plumb as it gets and half the side is back in the hut now. The Lankans are making a mockery of the contest now. Having wickets for fun. Herath draws level with Vettori for the most Test wickets by a left-arm spinner.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and blocks it to the covers.
MAHMUDULLAH is the new batsman in, replacing Shakib!

Gets it off the glove and the ball goes towards leg gully where Karunaratne takes a very good low catch inches above the ground. The Lankans are on a roll, JUST 6 WICKETS MORE NEEDED.
Shakib seems to be caught at leg gully. They are going upstairs to see if the catch has carried. Shakib has already started the walk.

Drifting in from outside off, Rahim steps out and nudges it to short mid-wicket.

OUT! ANOTHER ONE GOES! Superb catch by Gunaratne. The Lankans are buzzing at the moment and Dilruwan is breathing fire. Beautiful off break around off, a bit of turn and extra bounce as Tamim looks to push at it. The ball flies off the shoulder of the blade to first slip where Asela takes a very sharp catch moving quickly to his left. Bangladesh are imploding here. SRI LANKA NEED 7 MORE WICKETS.
Full and around off, Tamim presses forward to block at it but gets it off the inside half to the leg side.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly.
Tossed up wider outside off, presses forward and pushes it towards short cover.
Flatter and veering in on the pads, Tamim stays back and tucks it through backward square leg for a couple.
Looped up on middle and leg, Rahim gets his bat down in time and nudges it to short leg.
Around the wicket now.
Angling in on off, keeps a touch low as Rahim defends firmly off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Rahim stays back and defends with the full face of the bat.
Fuller this time and Rahim presses forward to defend it solidly.
A touch short around off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Rahim stays back and blocks it solidly.
On middle and leg, gets back and clips it on the leg side for a single.
MUSHFIQUR RAHIM is the new man in, replacing Haque! He was excellent in the first innings and he needs to do the same again.

OUT! GONE! The umpire's call and Mominul has to walk back to the hut. It was a lovely off break on middle, turns away a shade to rap him on the back pad. Loud lbw appeal and it is given. Lot of drama as Mominul signals the review and then Tamim advises him against it. Too late though and the umpires say that it's too late to change the decision. What drama! Legal ball and no bat involved. Impact in line and clipping the top of the middle stump. The on-field call will stay and Mominul has to go. All of a sudden, the visitors are trembling here.

Bizarre again. Mominul is given out lbw and he opts for the review. Initially, he had signaled but then seems like his partner told him not to. Too late as the signal was already made. Which means that it will be referred. Is there anything Bangladesh cannot do without drama? This appeal looks close to the naked eye though.
Floated outside off, Haque pushes at it but gets an edge to the off side.
Full and around off, Mominul pushes at it but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and blocks solidly.
Nicely done! Fuller on middle and off, leans across and wrists it away through mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up three.
DILRUWAN PERERA comes on to bowl.
Length ball outside off, camps back and blocks firmly on to the track.
Good length around off, defends solidly from the crease.
Length ball outside off, Haque sits back and defends with the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, gets across and blocks well.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward to push at it but the ball goes off the inside edge past short leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, Tamim gets back to steer it to third man but gets a bottom edge that rolls towards the off side.
Length ball angled in from around off, Mominul defends it solidly towards short cover.
On middle and leg, Mominul gets across and clips it on the leg side.
Good length outside off, stays back and defends it solidly.
Good length angled in around off, blocked solidly from the crease.

FOUR! Four leg byes! Another boundary! Lakmal once again loses his radar and slips it on the pads, Mominul delicately clips it down the leg side to the fine leg fence for a boundary. It has come off the pads.
FOUR! Pleasant stroke! Lakmal starts with an overpitched delivery, Mominul just leans forward and caresses the drive through the vacant mid off region as the ball whistles to the fence.
SURANGA LAKMAL to bowl from the other end.
Fuller outside off, pushed gently towards cover.
Looped up outside off, Tamim defends it off the front foot.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and defends it solidly.
Full and on the pads, worked away on the leg side for a single.
MOMINUL HAQUE is the new man in!

OUT! GONE! Gunaratne has his man! Lovely delivery this from Gunaratne as he floats it around off, the ball straightens after pitching as the ball beats the outside edge to clip the stumps. Huge excitement among the Lankans and the umpire slowly acknowledges the dismissal. It wasn't clear initially as to whether the ball had clipped the bails. Sarkar wasn't sure either and he actually thought of reviewing it. Probably, he expected the umpires to check a replay themselves to clear his confusion and when they didn't, he thought of it. Funny in the end. Dream start for the Lankans.

ALMOST A WICKET! What a start that would have been for Sri Lanka! Very loose from Sarkar though. Tries to play a half-hearted sweep but gets a faint top edge. Just bobbles over the short leg fielder. That was close!
The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. The weather seems pleasant at the moment with clear blue skies. ASELA GUNARATNE to complete his over.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold says Sri Lanka have to be tactically smart. Adds weather can become an issue for them. Further says Bangladesh will have to trust their defense. Informs there is plenty of rough on either side and Sri Lanka need to attack that. Ends by saying Herath should bowl to the left-handers while Perera should be given the ball when a right-handed batsman is in.

Hello and welcome to the final day's play. Sri Lanka are clearly favorites but will need to bowl better than they did yesterday. With all 10 wickets left in the tank, Bangladesh will fancy their chances of saving the game. If they have wickets in hand going into the final session, they may even have a crack at an improbable win but that is a long, long way away. A draw would be their realistic aim. Weather forecast isn't great and so that should aid them if they apply themselves. Crucial first session for both teams. The action begins in a short while.
.....DAY 5, SESSION 1.....

Earlier in the day, Tharanga's century led the charge for the Lankans as they built on their mammoth 182-run first innings lead with solid batting before declaring just after tea. Chasing a big target in a little under four sessions is always a monumental effort and a realistic approach is always to draw the match. Bangladesh's reply has been positive though and sets up the final day nicely. Barring a miracle, just two results remain in the game, weather permitting. Tune in at 0945 local, 0415 GMT for the final day's play. Cheers!

A good finish to the day for Bangladesh with their openers once again starting well. Sarkar was the aggressor, slamming an attacking fifty while Tamim held one end up. The pair's partnership has given the visitors belief as they look to save this Test. Sri Lanka's bowlers were erratic in this brief phase and leaked runs as well. Probably the break came at the right time for them. They can come back afresh tomorrow with new plans.
Update 1710 local - The expected news it out. PLAY HAS BEEN CALLED OFF FOR THE DAY.

Update 1655 local - The umpires feel that the light isn't sufficient for play to continue. The clouds had been gathering for a while now. Seems quite murky at the moment. The Lankans aren't happy, understandably so. Herath has a chat with the umpire expressing his disappointment. The ground staff comes in with the covers as a precaution.

A false start from Gunaratne! It's on a length and around off, Sarkar looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards fine leg. The umpire calls it a no ball as Asela cut the side line in his delivery stride. They take a couple.
ASELA GUNARATNE is called into the attack now!
Leans forward and across and defends it towards short leg.
Stays behind the line and defends it with a straight bat.
Flat and short around off, Tamim taps it towards the off side.
Full around off, Iqbal lunges forward and keeps it out.
Short and outside off, punched it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Full and around off, Sarkar presses forward and blocks.
Drinks break...
Loopy outside off, dabbed towards the man at first slip.
3rd Test fifty for Sarkar.
Drops it short and around off, drop and run from Sarkar towards covers for a single. Back-to-back half centuries for Soumya! Need to convert this into a big one this time.
SIX! Wallop! Herath serves a tossed up ball around middle and leg, Sarkar advances down the track, takes it on the full and hits it over mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Comes nicely forward and blocks it out.
Full outside off, double S comes forward to defend but gets it off the outer part of the bat past first slip for a couple.
Tossed up around off, turning in, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Flatter through the air, Sarkar cuts it towards the backward point fielder.
FOUR! And again! Gets another short ball and Soumya feasts on it. Stays back and packs a punch past covers for another boundary of the over.
Loopy ball around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! Drops it short and outside off, Sarkar camps back and punches it cleanly through cover-point for a boundary.
Quicker through the air around middle, defended towards short leg.
DILRUWAN PERERA has a change of ends.
Driven past mid off for a single.

Poor throw! Tossed up on middle, Sarkar comes forward to defend but gets it off the inner half of the bat past short leg. They take a single and there is some hesitation between the two. The fielder fires a wayward throw at the keeper's end and now they take another.
FOUR! Lovely hit! Floats it up around off, Sarkar gets down and nails the sweep through square leg for a boundary. Off the meat it went!
Tossed up outside off, Sarkar prods forward and keeps it out.
Loopy around off, knocked down to long on for a single.
Full and around off, Tamim defends it by lunging forward.
Banged in short around off, Sarkar ducks under the bouncer with ease.
Good length closer to off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Back of a length outside off, Sarkar rises on his toes and blocks it towards cover.
Leg gully is in place.
On middle and off, gets across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Dug in short on middle, almost the kind of shot that got him out in the first innings but this time Sarkar controlled the pull better towards deep backward square leg. A single taken.
Good length closer to off, Sarkar gets right behind the line and blocks well.
Floated around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Full and around off, Tamim drives it firmly back to the bowler.
Flatter ball outside off, Sarkar gets back and glides it towards third man with an open face. The batsmen get three.
Floated on middle and off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, leans across and pushes it towards long on for a single.
That was close! Floated around off, Sarkar gets across to drive across but gets it off the inside half. The ball just evades the short mid-wicket fielder Chandimal who put in a leap but in vain.
Full and outside off, Tamim gets the stride forward and blocks it towards cover.
Good length angled in from around off, Tamim gets the big stride forward and blocks it down the pitch.
Fuller and wider outside off, a hint of away swing, Tamim offers no stroke to that one.
Full and outside off, defends it solidly off the front foot.
Back of a length from around off, stays back and blocks it solidly on to the track.
Full and outside off, Tamim makes a good leave to the keeper.
Flighted outside off, presses forward and defends solidly.
Fuller on middle and off, worked gently to the leg side.
FOUR! SUPERB SHOT! Flighted on off, Sarkar gets across to that one and whips it away through mid-wicket. Lovely stroke and the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, Tamim gets back to push at it but gets it off the edge towards third man for a brace.
Floated on middle and leg, turning in a touch as Tamim glances it away down to fine leg. The batsmen will pick up three.
Floated outside off, spinning in, Tamim adjusts and blocks it towards cover.
RANGANA HERATH is introduced into the attack.
Dug in short from around off, Sarkar swivels to pull but misses as the ball flies over his head to the keeper.
Good length angled in from around off, blocked solidly from the crease to the bowler.

Doesn't carry! Good length angled in from outside off, Sarkar flashes at it but gets a thick edge that doesn't carry to the man at gully. Gets through him and the ball races to the third man region for a brace.
Short of a length outside off, gets back to that one and taps it towards the off side.
Good length outside off, Sarkar plays with an angled bat towards point.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards short cover.
Looped in from outside off, Tamim gets well on the front foot and defends solidly towards cover.
Flighted outside off, Sarkar pushes it behind square of the wicket on the off side for a single. It went off the outer half of the blade.
Fuller on middle and leg, Tamim needles it through backward square leg for a single.
Flighted outside off, gets well forward and pats it towards cover.
Slightly shorter outside off, gets back and pushes it towards the off side for a single.
FOUR! Slammed! Sarkar seems to be continuing from where he left off in the first innings. Tossed up ball outside off, very full and he powers the drive through extra cover to find the fence.
The sucker ball, pitched up outside off, Tamim lets it pass to the keeper.
Dug in short outside off, Tamim rises on his toes to drop it towards cover-point with a gently nudge.
Dug in short on middle, Tamim ducks under the bumper comfortably.
Pitched up and outside off, leans into it and defends solidly towards cover.
Fullish and outside off, Tamim reaches out and pushes it towards cover.
Good length outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks it towards short cover.
Slightly short and outside off, Tamim sits back and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Tossed up gently around off, leans forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Slightly shorter outside off, Tamim camps back and blocks it to the off side.
Flighted around leg stump, gets across and sweeps it towards backward square leg where Lakmal makes a good stop to save a certain boundary. Single taken.
Flatter ball outside off, gets forward and pushes it towards point.
Floated and fuller on the stumps, Sarkar gets on the front foot and defends solidly.
Beaten! Excellent over from Lakmal. Length ball slanting in from around off, straightens after pitching as Tamim is beaten on the poke.

EDGE FALLS SHORT! Good length angled in from around off, squares up Tamim who pushes at it meekly. Gets the thick edge that is dying on Mendis who dives to his left at third slip but the ball doesn't carry to him. He gets hit on the hand while trying to stop the ball but thankfully, no harm done.
Good length outside off, stays back and blocks it towards the covers.
Around the wicket.
FOUR! SHOT! Elegant from Tamim. Fuller ball outside off, leans forward and strokes the drive effortlessly through the covers. Excellent timing!
Fuller on middle, swinging in, Tamim gets across and pushes it towards mid on.
Good length on middle and leg, Tamim clips it gently towards the leg side.
Length ball angled away around off, Sarkar defends it solidly from the crease.
Fuller and on off, defended solidly from the crease.

FOUR! That's a freebie and Sarkar feasts on it. Full toss around middle, he gets across to that one and whips it away through mid-wicket. Struck it well and there is nobody in the deep on the leg side to save the boundary.
Flighted fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks it towards cover.
Tossed up outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Dickwella seems to have split the webbing of his glove, that's a rare event. The 12th man is coming with a replacement set.
Finds the edge straightaway! Flatter and just outside off, Sarkar pushes at it tentatively and gets the outside edge. Flies wide of the slip fielder and rolls to third man as the batsmen get two.
DILRUWAN PERERA to share the new ball.
Fuller and slanting across Tamim who shoulders arms to that one.

Play and a miss! Lakmal gets his line and length right for the first time in the over and nearly has his man. Good length around the fourth stump line, a bit of away movement as Tamim pushes at it but misses.
Good length sprayed way outside off, too wide to make the batsman play.
Fuller and outside off, a bit of away swing as Tamim lets it pass.
Good length angling across the left-hander, Tamim plays well inside the line to make a leave.
Length ball around off, Tamim gets well forward and blocks it solidly to cover.
